title: AIChE 101
authors_text: Katherine J. Gawel and Meagan Lewis
abstract: This session will provide an overview of the operating structure of AIChE including an overview on each of the operation councils. This session will also discuss divisions, committees, and local sections. In addition to giving an overview of each of these groups, the session will also go into detail about the different ways you can get involved in one or many of these groups. This session will be of particular interest to Young Professionals and those who are new to AIChE membership or involvement in AIChE on a national level.

title: Navigating the AIChE Annual Conference
authors_text: Katherine J. Gawel and Meagan Lewis
abstract: This session will review the logistics of the conference including understanding the program book and how sessions are organized. It will also highlight key networking opportunities throughout the conference. In addition to reviewing the logistics of navigating the conference, it will go through a brief overview of how the conference is put together and how you can become a speaker or session chair. The second half of the session will be devoted to questions and answers as well as a networking opportunity. This session will be of particular interest to Young Professionals and anyone who is attending a National AIChE Conference for the first time.
